resolution.note: Worker instructions now ask to finish the brief and leave changes uncommitted; start refuses forbidden --allow (exit 64); partial/blocked without a blocker exits 4

title: Make worker turns finish briefs and commit allowed paths
body:
Outcome: a krn worker turn that the brief asks to finish and commit does so, or reports a concrete blocker. Evidence (PR #182, .krn/runs/lead/gate-infra-rerun/rounds): gpt-6-luna at high effort returned status partial twice (41k then 75k uncached tokens) with no blocker; round 2 refused to commit citing an overriding instruction that the lead commits, and called .agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md read-only although it was in --allow. The lead finished the slice by hand.
Proof: a fixture worker turn with an allowed .agents path can write it, and the worker instructions no longer forbid the commit the brief asks for (or the brief template stops asking); one recorded live turn completes a small brief end to end.
